Drs that are lo
vely and caring.
Jenny Standing has been consistant/ hugely helpful/diagnostically marvelous with my several health issues and always goes out of her way to make sure i am getting the proper and best care for them! I feel like it's a personal old style surgery with her and reception esp Ellen who greets me and knows me, so reassuring.
Dr Brunskill so lovely and caring, he always has time for the 'personal chat' during a consultstion/phone call which makes a big difference!
Nurses too all very nice.
It's a friendly surgery, i have been a patient for  aprox 37 years when i originally saw Dr Ansell, between her and Jenny Standing ALL my unusual/chronic conditions have been identified diagnosed and the ongoing treatments at the RUH  found, i owe my quality of life to them and so grateful.
